title: Welcome to the Notes REST API
content: This is a basic REST API built with Node.js and Express. It supports full CRUD operations.

title: Learn Express Middleware
content: Explore how express.json(), CORS, and request logging middleware work together in a pipeline.

title: Test with Postman
content: Import postman_collection.json or send requests via cURL to test GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE endpoints.
